groups.intro: A group is a bucket for expenses you want to track together: shared household costs, a trip, a wedding. You can use one on your own too — sharing is optional. Your own ledger and balance stay unchanged.
groups.inviteHint: The link is valid for 7 days and can be used once. Share it only with the person you want in this group — anyone holding the link can join.
groups.leaveConfirm: If you leave, the entries you marked for this group become personal again; nothing is deleted. Continue?
groups.removeConfirm: If you remove this member, their entries stay in their own ledger as personal. Continue?
groups.payerBreakdownHint: When off, the group screen hides how much each person paid; the total and categories stay visible.
groups.acceptIntro: If you accept, expenses marked for this group become visible to both of you. Your own ledger, balance and ungrouped entries are not shared.
groups.acceptSignInHint: Sign in first to accept the invite — you will be brought back here.

consent.title: Voice entry needs your consent
consent.body: The audio you record with push-to-talk is sent to Google Gemini to be turned into an entry. The recording is not stored on our servers; it is only held in memory for the duration of that request. You can withdraw this consent any time from Settings.

cashflow.title: Cash Flow
cashflow.chartAriaLabel: Projected cash balance chart for the coming days
cashflow.cumulativeGainSentence: Keeping this in a daily-interest account up to this date would have earned ~{gain} more.
cashflow.evdsContext: TLREF overnight reference rate, the basis for the daily-account estimate (as of {asOf}): {rate}
cashflow.rateLabel: Rate used for the daily-interest calculation (annual)
cashflow.disclaimer: Net estimate (17.5% withholding tax already deducted); assumes a liquid, anytime-accessible daily-interest account — not locked like a term deposit. Actual returns vary by bank and product. Not investment advice.

dailyAccount.title: What you'd earn with daily interest
dailyAccount.sentence: If you left this balance untouched in a daily-interest account, you'd have ~{gain} more after {days} days.

termDeposit.title: Term deposit alternative
termDeposit.balanceSentence: Over {days} days, your balance never drops below {minBalance}.
termDeposit.planSentence: Keeping about 3 months of expenses ({buffer}) in your liquid daily account and locking the remaining {lockable} into a 1-month term deposit would net you roughly {combinedGain} in total interest.
termDeposit.allDailySentence: Keeping all of it in the daily account instead would net an estimated <g>{allDailyGain}</g>.
termDeposit.extraGainSentence: That means you could earn <g>{extraGain}</g> more.
termDeposit.noExtraGainSentence: In this case, both approaches land close to the same result.
termDeposit.caveat: Source: TCMB's ~1-month TL time-deposit average, {rate} (as of {asOf}). Over longer windows the term deposit is assumed to renew every ~30 days at today's rate; the real rate may differ at each renewal. Withdrawing before maturity usually forfeits that term's interest.

statements.uploadSheetDescription: Upload a credit card statement PDF to import your expenses into the ledger.
statements.consentText: The credit card statement you upload is sent to OpenAI's (US-based) AI service to parse the transaction lines (date, description, amount). Your card number, ID information, and address are never included in this and are never stored on our servers. The raw file is discarded after processing, never kept.

creditCards.startingDebtHint: If this card already had a balance before you started using the app, enter it here — it's added once as a starting balance so debt tracking begins from the right number.
creditCards.debtExplanation: Your card charges minus the payments you've made. Cash flow assumes this debt gets paid off in full on the payment day unless you say otherwise — an early or partial payment you log adjusts that.

payDebt.dialogDescription: Log how much you paid toward this card — full balance or a partial/minimum payment, either way. This affects your cash flow on this date; if you enter it wrong, you can delete it from History.
